name: practice-focus
description: Confines the workbench to the one file its window's URL opened: no sidebar, no panel, no other editors.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: It closes workbench surfaces and reads no file, no setting and no workspace content.

studyforge.practice.main.description: Workspace-relative path of the file the reader edits. Written by the study server, which excludes exactly this path from files.readonlyExclude; not meant to be edited by hand. Declared here so the workbench accepts the key rather than flagging it unknown -- this extension does not read it.

studyforge.practice.test.description: Workspace-relative path of the test that judges it. Written by the study server and left read-only. Declared here for the same reason as the key above; which file a window shows is decided by that window's URL, not by this setting.
